title: Stasis & Ember
description: A mystical purple-walled study filled with candles and magical artifacts. A woman with purple hair in a floral robe sits at a desk writing in a large book beside an ornate glass display cabinet containing glowing potions, a floating magical orb, and dripping green liquid.
prompt: A cozy yet mystical purple fantasy study interior with a woman with purple braided hair wearing a floral robe sitting at a wooden desk writing in a large tome. Next to her is an ornate white glass display cabinet with open doors revealing glowing magical potions, a large purple magical orb, and dripping green liquid. The room is filled with dozens of lit red, teal and gold candles, scrolls, potion bottles, and framed magical symbols on the walls. A red banner hangs reading 'SLOT 29 STASIS 898e8139'. Warm atmospheric candlelight illuminates the scene.
